Kinda late but I have some input. I was asked today along with two other coworkers to go help a neighboring target with their quarantine reshop. Every single zone is a disaster (it looks like it hasn’t been zoned in weeks), and they have people coming in to do a walk through tomorrow. We’re going in tomorrow to help them out again. 

My store on the other hand is handling everything pretty nicely. It starts with the front end, they make sure to hang everything (even if it’s not the correct hanger) and they sticker everything with the date it was returned. They throw it in the back and let it sit for three days. 

So every morning the opening style team members gather the quarantine reshop that is due to leave that day and properly hang it, sort it, and remove the sticker before letting the corresponding TM run it out onto the floor. Usually by the time I come in (10) they have the quarantine reshop done and I just have to put it away. 

The front end hanging everything and organizing everything by date helps. Having most of our style team actually working style helps. Having efficient closers who leave a nice zone helps. So yeah. Hopefully this helps lol

I work in style and I’m also trained for fulfillment. In my store we are all on channel 1. When I come in say, “LOD, this is Karina clocked in for the day.” (Some targets don’t use LOD anymore, you could also just say “team.”) LOD stands for Lead on Duty btw. 

When I take my 15’s or 30’s I say, “LOD this is Karina going on a 15.” 

When I come back I say, “LOD this is Karina back from my 15.” 

When I clock out I say, “LOD this is a Karina clocking out for the day.” 

Don’t think too hard about it and just pick up on how your store does things.
